basic_info.description: Beautifully renovated 3BR/2BA ground-floor unit in a 6-unit Pac Heights building, blending classic charm with modern finishes. Bright and spacious with high ceilings, crown moldings, and a wood-carved fireplace framed by bay windows and bench seating. Chefs kitchen features Viking appliances, custom sustainable cabinetry, quartz counters, Blanco sink, and undercabinet lighting. Large dining room ideal for entertaining. Guest bath with frameless shower and porcelain tile, plus utility closet with Washer/Dryer. Two serene bedrooms, including one with garden view. Primary suite offers spa-like bath with double-sink vanity and walk-in closet. Wide-plank oak floors and recessed lighting throughout. Includes 1-car garage, 2 storage areas, and access to a shared mature garden. Prime location near Alta Plaza Park, schools, shops, cafes, and transit.
